# Management API Route Table

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen-management-routes.py from ManagementRoute.java and ManagementRoutePermissions.java. Do not edit by hand; CI fails on drift. -->

Every registered management route: 201 entries. The narrative sections are in [management-api.md](management-api.md); this table is the complete, mechanically maintained inventory.

- **Role** is the minimum authorization role: reads (`GET`) need `VIEWER`; a mutation needs the role named by `ManagementRoutePermissions`, and a mutation it does not list needs `ADMIN`.
- **Served by** is the routing target: `LOCAL` answers on the node that received the request, `LEADER` forwards to the cluster leader, `ANY` is served from any core node, `taskGroup(X)` forwards to a node hosting that task group, `nodeIdParam(n)` forwards to the node named by path parameter n.
- `{param}` segments are path parameters. Health probes and `/repository` routes are unversioned (no `/api/v1`).
- Two routes, `WORKERS_HEALTH` and `WORKERS_ENDPOINTS`, are registered as honest `501 Not Implemented` stubs.
